Test fonts: subsets of Noto Sans (regular, italic) and Roboto Slab (bold) as served by Google Fonts for the text
"Hello World WOFF2 test 1234567890äöü€", in WOFF2 and in WOFF 1.0. Both fonts are licensed under the
SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org): Noto Sans © 2022 The Noto Project Authors,
Roboto Slab © 2018 The Roboto Slab Project Authors.

`NotoSansDevanagari-Regular.ttf`, `NotoSansTamil-Regular.ttf` and `NotoSansArabic-Regular.ttf` are the complete
hinted fonts from the Noto project (https://github.com/notofonts), © 2022 The Noto Project Authors, also under the
SIL Open Font License 1.1. They test complex-script shaping (GSUB and GPOS).
